Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (9)

For Talaris to leave the front lines meant that those under her protection would die. However, Talaris did not hesitate in her decision. As soon as she received Leuth's call, she withdrew from the center of the front line and entered Lafrarosa.
Talaris was already covered in blood. She had been positioned at the final defensive line, blocking the enemies who had broken through the protective shields of Murakan, Bale, and Lafrarosa.
The blood she had shed was as much as the enemy's. It was to the point where the enemy Genesis Knights' magic could be seen still blazing on her wounds, not yet faded.
[...Lady of the Secret Palace, will a sealing be possible in your condition?]
"Hmph, I have to do it no matter what, what else can I do? If I can't send my son-in-law to that place, there's no future."
[I will have Her Majesty the Holy King attend to you while the sealing is in progress.]
"No, it's fine. Without Her Majesty's touch, I'll at most suffer more internal injuries, but other people will die. Instead, tell my daughter to protect this mother's position."
[Understood.]
Immediately, a chill began to spread throughout the workshop area. With Myriad Ice in Syris's possession, she had no choice but to shoulder more risk to perform the great sealing.
Lucy and Syris took Talaris's place on the final defensive line. One worrying for her daughter, the other for her mother.
[Young Lady of the Palace, the Lady of the Secret Palace is a strong person, unlike me.]
"Lord Lucy's daughter will also be a stronger person than I."
They soon calmed their emotions. Emotions that didn't help in a fight would only make reality worse.
The enemies swarmed in. And beyond the two blades, Dragon Sword and Myriad Ice, that were spewing sword aura, Joshua and Araxion were just arriving at the battlefield.
[Jin.]
"Joshua..."

Jin wasn't too surprised to see Joshua, who had obtained the power of Iloanu. It was because he had recognized the fact that he had merged with him from the moment the Sun God's egos and the Ganestos had arrived.

The sight of Joshua, glowing brightly with Iloanu's sun energy without a single wound, was contrasted with the sight of the Coalition's Genesis Knights, whose bodies were repeatedly aging and disappearing as they endured Kelliark's attacks.
"You've managed to come this far without dying, like a bug."
[I came to provide support, so there's no need to look at me with such venomous eyes.]

"Support? Even with the world in this state, you all must have just barged into the battlefield to somehow look after your own interests. Even if you truly fight until you fall in battle, your honor will not be remembered. No one will thank you or your family."
[I know. It's just that something more important than that has arisen for me now. Mother... is helping the great serpent for your sake. Until that is done, you must survive.]
Jin didn't answer and shifted his gaze to Haylin. She had already jumped into the midst of Kelliark's magic and was assisting the Coalition's Genesis Knights.

Unlike Joshua, Haylin was not at fault. The fault all belonged to Araxion. Also, although Lokia had spoken as if she had perfect control over Araxion, circumstantially, it was highly likely that the one Araxion truly followed was not her but Malugia.
'As a descendant, I pray that you do not end those terrible years merely as a vessel chosen by monsters.'

As Haylin began to emit sun energy in earnest, Malugia's energy was exploding. As Jin had expected, Araxion followed Malugia, not Lokia, and their relationship was more special than that of the other egos of destruction.

They were the only two egos who had realized the multiverse a thousand years ago. From that time, the two egos had learned to link their powers as if they were human. To prepare for a situation just like this.
"Araxion, and Iloanu, and the dregs of the dimension. All sorts of things are coming out and getting on my nerves. But Orgal, surely you didn't talk big to me believing in trash like this?"
[Kuaaaargh!]
Orgal's body rapidly shriveled. The Light Origin magic that had formed around him was piercing him like an awl.
"When it comes to lifespan, our Plutonian isn't too shabby either. I shall now shoulder a little more, Orgal."
Vahn's blade cut through the magic that had pierced Orgal. The aging inflicted on Vahn became more dangerous by that much, but it wasn't enough to end her in one go.

[Thank you. Yes... I can't fall like this. No matter how old and decrepit I become, I am Orgal, the King of Demons. I am the one chosen for a terrible fate, to block your ambition until the very, very end!]
If Lokia released the curse as planned, the Coalition now had to endure for five hours. That fact would soon be relayed to the Coalition's Genesis Knights.
Kelliark also knew that the time the Coalition had to endure had been reduced. And in his mind, there was still no hope for the Coalition.

"Struggle as much as you want. Come to think of it, it's only natural that this dimension is special. Those countless worlds all began when the Origin Stone was created here a thousand years ago. In that sense, to me, this dimension is no different from the god who created me. Today, I am killing a god for the first time. Not some immortals who are merely called gods."
Joshua's sword rushed towards Kelliark's neck.
It had tremendous destructive power as it contained the power of Iloanu, but the fundamental problem was that it was Joshua who was using that power.
He was a person who did not belong on this battlefield.
Although he had found his own value and gained enlightenment after awakening as a Ganesto and finally found inner peace, he was still Joshua.
He had never even come close to the level of a Genesis Knight, nor had he ever completed his own sword. All he had done was meet a dark savior and obtain great power.
His sword was not deep enough to face a battle of superhumans, let alone Genesis Knights, and even the hegemon of all dimensions who surpassed them.
Kelliark casually waved his hand as if swatting a fly to push him away, then created a space explosion in that spot, instantly turning him into chunks of meat.
However, the ego of the Sun God was basically a being close to immortal. His scattered bones and flesh quickly gathered in the air and reshaped him.
Regenerative power. That was the only ability Joshua possessed right now that could be called transcendent.
"Ah, I see. When dealing with the Sun God, erasing existence is the best method, but you are so weak that I momentarily forgot that fact."
[Annihilation... I do not fear it, for the sake of my mother.]
"Hah. Chiron, how did you end up with something like this for a child? You do have your shortcomings."
Chiron didn't even glance at Joshua. All the Genesis Knights except for Jin did the same. He was that meaningless and unpleasant an existence.
It was no different for Kelliark. In fact, Kelliark was even feeling that Joshua was desecrating this battle, so it seemed best to quickly raise the Dark Origin magic and erase him.
The gathering black Dark Origin magic enveloped Joshua. Kelliark passed by him, who had turned into a black cocoon, and located the Coalition's Genesis Knights and Haylin.
But the next moment, Kelliark narrowed his eyes and had to look back.
'...This bug wasn't erased in one go?'

He had poured quite a lot of Dark Origin magic with the feeling of erasing Iloanu rather than killing Joshua, but Joshua was escaping from between the Dark Origin magic, having turned into a kind of slime.
Soon, that slime showed signs of forming Joshua's body again.
[Heok, heok... keok...]
Joshua bent at the waist, letting out ragged breaths as if the blow was severe, but it was Kelliark who was more shocked.

"How absurd... Your fake mother seems to possess quite a remarkable ability. She modified Iloanu, didn't she? No, it would be more correct to say she devolved it. She crushed its reason and enhanced only its life force, which wasn't even necessary. Come to think of it, that must be why Iloanu can't control your consciousness."
Kelliark was genuinely flabbergasted.
Even when he repeatedly created space explosions and spread the net of Dark Origin, Joshua would turn into a dirty slime again and regenerate.

A waste product that could no longer be called human or a Sun God, that didn't even decompose well. Kelliark classified Joshua as such. It was as if a fly that wouldn't die easily had intruded while he was dealing with wild beasts.
[Guaaargh, keuhak...!]
And that, unexpectedly, was becoming quite a big variable.
Piit-!
A streak of blood splattered from Kelliark's cheek. In the gap where he was so flabbergasted that his attention was momentarily diverted to Joshua, Luna had approached.

It was a dangerous and bold move. But until now, Luna hadn't been able to seize such an opportunity. And while the blood splattered, Haylin's sword stabbed Kelliark's back, and in the moment the two were thrown back, the swords of Chiron and Vahn rushed in.
The single mistake Kelliark had made was creating a chain of openings.
It was a development that no one had expected until just now. Not even the ones who had transcended destiny, not even the predator who had conquered all dimensions by trampling such beings.
On the contrary, because the destiny Joshua possessed was so unspeakably pathetic, no one had been able to read him.
Of course, the precious magic of Valeria and Enya was not used on Joshua. In the first place, he was volunteering to be an expendable item that didn't need to be protected.
"Kuhk!"

Kelliark let out a short groan. Blood gushed from his mouth. He couldn't easily shake off the Genesis Knights as he had been doing all along. It was because Malugia was making his magic disappear, her eyes shining.

Malugia's sun energy, amplified by its resonance with Araxion, was surpassing the power she had shown in the Empire last time. No matter how strong Kelliark was, he couldn't easily offset that energy with a body that had not 'completely' recovered.
In other words, for the first time since the battle began, Kelliark was facing a minor crisis.
[Ggggh, uuuugh...]
Joshua's low groans, who had already repeated annihilation and regeneration five times, were scattering futilely into the roar of the battlefield.
